scope: Immutable source and completed timing archive only. No remote calls, simulation, or R.

validation_seeds.chunk_index_assumption: c=0..9 (package does not choose zero- or one-based)

shared_sensitivity_family.finding: No task suballocation is given. Separate build_bank invocations restart task index at zero.

launcher_interpretation: Driver catches child-process failure and incomplete line count. DONE means transport completion only; it neither validates trial IDs nor evaluates scientific gates. These fixtures do not assert that such outputs occurred in real runs.

generator_timing.scope: Outer generation only; no bank loading, neighbour selection, reference fitting or covariance.
generator_timing.fixed_in_timing_source: BETA_MIN = 0.9745192683713976; designated-bank effect output is not consumed.

pending_contract: A manifest mapping scenario, chunk, stream, parameters, intended count and output directory; a final fixed-denominator scenario aggregation and gate report.
Fit-failure rate denominator: T-output failed flag counts a four-statistic dataset; final scenario accounting must cover observed, training and test replicates, including incomplete trials.
Concurrency ceiling: run_arms starts every supplied arm concurrently; the measured 28 GB per process and 125 GB host prohibit launching all ten chunks together.
Unique suballocation for repeated sensitivity-family 8.7e12 jobs, or explicit intended stream reuse.
All-scenario end-to-end cost remains projected; 13 generator-only timings cannot establish total equality to within one percent.
